fi-gymnothorax-tile.title: Snowflake Freshwater Moray Eel
fi-gymnothorax-tile.summary: The 'freshwater' moray eel, Gymnothorax tile, is a moray from coastal regions of the Indo-West Pacific, from eastern India to the Philippines. Although typically sold as a freshwater fish, this is…
rows: Usually kept singly (or a known pair when breeding)
Predator / carnivore. An obligate predator feeding on smaller fishes, crustaceans and suchlike in nature.
Widespread throughout coastal regions of the Indo-West Pacific from eastern India to the Philippines and southward to Indonesia , Type locality is ' Ganges River estuaries near Calcutta, India'.
notes: Although typically sold as a freshwater fish this is not strictly the case (see 'Habitat'), thus the addition of a marine salt mix should be considered mandatory.
Aim for around 15 g/l although it is not essential to be exact.

fi-mastacembelus-armatus.title: Tiretrack Eel
fi-mastacembelus-armatus.summary: The tyre-track eel, Mastacembelus armatus, is a spiny eel from India, Thailand and Sumatra, also known as the white-spotted spiny eel. Growing to around 91 cm, it hides during the day and often…
rows: Herbivore / algae browser. Prefers meaty foods such as prawn, krill , and lancefish.
notes: Tank should be well planted with floating plants also used.
An abundance of hiding places should be provided as this species likes to hide away during the day.

fi-mastacembelus-erythrotaenia.title: Fire Eel
fi-mastacembelus-erythrotaenia.summary: The fire eel, Mastacembelus erythrotaenia, is a spiny eel recorded from Laos, Vietnam, Cambodia, Thailand, Malaysia and Indonesia. It usually inhabits sluggish lowland waters including floodplains…
rows: Predator / carnivore. Wild fish are omnivorous and consume a variety of smaller fish, aquatic invertebrates, plant matter and detritus .
Recorded from Laos , Vietnam , Cambodia , Thailand , Malaysia and Indonesia .
notes: Tank should be well planted with floating plants also used.
An abundance of hiding places should be provided as this species likes to hide away during the day.
